checks.label: dedicated Chrome is a separate persistent process with two owned groups
live unsent form values are preserved without serializing them to disk
clean DSH-controller shutdown leaves Chrome and all live tabs open
restart reconnects the same process and preserves native group and tab IDs
login cookies remain in the same live browser across controller restart
old observations and reusable approvals do not survive restart
a restored session cannot read another group or an unclaimed page
existing second session can reconnect independently
a hard controller-process kill still leaves Chrome and unsent data alive
orphaned in-page control indication hides when its controller is gone
a fresh controller recovers after hard kill without opening duplicates
stop binding is reconnected and trusted Escape still stops the right session
closing one group does not close another group or unclaimed tabs
explicitly released tabs are not silently reclaimed after another restart

method: Separate Node controller processes, detached Chrome, clean shutdown and hard kill
